records.jp: それじゃあ、愛央ちゃん！
records.en_original: Okay, Ao!
records.en: Okay, Ao!

records.jp: はい、陽桜莉さん！
records.en_original: Yes, ma'am!
records.en: Yes, ma'am!

records.jp: 今日のお昼は、ふたりで<CR>カレーを作りたいと思います！
records.en_original: Today we'll be making curry for lunch!
records.en: Today we'll be making curry for lunch!

records.jp: はーい！
records.en_original: Roger that!
records.en: Roger that!

records.jp: ここに、甘口と辛口のルーがあるんだけど<CR>愛央ちゃん、どっちがいい？
records.en_original: We have mild roux and spicy roux here. Which one do you want to make?
records.en: We have mild roux and spicy roux here. Which one do you want to make?

records.jp: んー、そうだなあ……
records.en_original: Hmm...
records.en: Hmm...

records.jp: 優しい感じの甘口がいいな
records.en_original: Let's go with the gentler flavor of the mild roux.
records.en: Let's go with the gentler flavor of the mild roux.

records.jp: うん、いいね！<CR>じゃあ、今日はお子様カレーに決定！
records.en_original: Sounds good! Let's make a curry like the kind you'd see on the kids menu!
records.en: Sounds good! Let's make a curry like the kind you'd see on the kids menu!

records.jp: 旗とか、たてちゃう？
records.en_original: Should we put a little flag in it, then?
records.en: Should we put a little flag in it, then?

records.jp: あ、かわいいかも！　やろう、やろう！
records.en_original: Oh, that'd be cute! Let's do it!
records.en: Oh, that'd be cute! Let's do it!

records.jp: ここは、ピリッと辛口でいこう！
records.en_original: Let's spice things up a little!
records.en: Let's spice things up a little!

records.jp: 夏に、ハフハフいいながら<CR>食べるカレーも美味しいもんね！
records.en_original: Yeah. I like curry that makes you huff and puff, especially in the summer!
records.en: Yeah. I like curry that makes you huff and puff, especially in the summer!

records.jp: そうそう！<CR>食べてる～って感じするよね、あれ！
records.en_original: Exactly! It makes it so much more satisfying!
records.en: Exactly! It makes it so much more satisfying!

records.jp: あー、想像したらお腹空いてきちゃった！<CR>早く、作ろ！
records.en_original: Ugh, I'm getting hungry just thinking about it. Let's hurry up and get cooking!
records.en: Ugh, I'm getting hungry just thinking about it. Let's hurry up and get cooking!

records.jp: うーん……悪くないけど<CR>何か足りないような気がするなぁ
records.en_original: Hmm... It's not bad, but it's missing a little something.
records.en: Hmm... It's not bad, but it's missing a little something.

records.jp: 隠し味でも、入れてみる？
records.en_original: Wanna add my secret ingredient?
records.en: Wanna add my secret ingredient?

records.jp: そうだね、何が良いかな
records.en_original: Sure! What do you have in mind?
records.en: Sure! What do you have in mind?

records.jp: うーん、これは？<CR>定番のチョコレート
records.en_original: How about a little chocolate? It's a classic.
records.en: How about a little chocolate? It's a classic.

records.jp: おお、それは定番だね！<CR>とりあえず、ふた欠片ぐらい入れてみよっか
records.en_original: Ooh! Can't go wrong with that! Let's put two squares in for now.
records.en: Ooh! Can't go wrong with that! Let's put two squares in for now.

records.jp: 残ったチョコはどうする？
records.en_original: What should we do with the leftover chocolate?
records.en: What should we do with the leftover chocolate?

records.jp: ……こっそり食べちゃう？
records.en_original: ...Eat it while no one's watching?
records.en: ...Eat it while no one's watching?

records.jp: あは！　それいいね、賛成！
records.en_original: Haha! Good idea, I'm in!
records.en: Haha! Good idea, I'm in!

records.jp: 愛情とか？
records.en_original: How about love?
records.en: How about love?

records.jp: 愛情？
records.en_original: Love?
records.en: Love?

records.jp: ほら、メイド喫茶でオムライスに<CR>愛情入れたりするじゃん！
records.en_original: Like the omelet rice they serve at maid cafes! The secret ingredient is always love!
records.en: Like the omelet rice they serve at maid cafes! The secret ingredient is always love!

records.jp: あー！　入れる入れる！<CR>でも、あれで味が変わったりするのかな？
records.en_original: Ooh! Let's do it! But will people actually taste the difference?
records.en: Ooh! Let's do it! But will people actually taste the difference?

records.jp: 料理は愛情っていうし、きっと変わるよ！
records.en_original: Of course they will! Like they say, cooking is an act of love!
records.en: Of course they will! Like they say, cooking is an act of love!

records.jp: そっか……よし、やってみる！
records.en_original: That's right... Okay, let's give it a try!
records.en: That's right... Okay, let's give it a try!

records.jp: （陽桜莉さんって、ほんとにすぐ信じるなー）
records.en_original: (Hiori will believe anything...)
records.en: (Hiori will believe anything...)

records.jp: ん～！　愛情、ちゅ～にゅ～！<CR>美味しくなーれ、美味しくなーれ！
records.en_original: Ngh! Love goes in! Yum comes out!
records.en: Ngh! Love goes in! Yum comes out!

records.jp: もっとだよ、もっと入れて！
records.en_original: More! More love!
records.en: More! More love!

records.jp: 好き好き、大好きー！！
records.en_original: I love you, I love you, I love you!!
records.en: I love you, I love you, I love you!!

records.jp: これで、どうかな？
records.en_original: What do you think?
records.en: What do you think?

records.jp: （素直すぎて、かわいい……）
records.en_original: (She's so innocent, it's adorable...)
records.en: (She's so innocent, it's adorable...)

records.jp: ……うん！　いい感じ！
records.en_original: Mmm! That's it!
records.en: Mmm! That's it!

records.jp: はい、愛央ちゃんも、あーん！
records.en_original: Here, Ao, say aah!
records.en: Here, Ao, say aah!

records.jp: あ、美味しい！
records.en_original: Oh, yum!
records.en: Oh, yum!

records.jp: だよね！　ほんとは、お母さんみたいなカレーが<CR>作りたかったんだけど……
records.en_original: Isn't it good? I tried to make it taste like mom's curry, but...
records.en: Isn't it good? I tried to make it taste like mom's curry, but...

records.jp: 私、陽桜莉さんのカレー好きだよ
records.en_original: I like your curry the best, Hiori!
records.en: I like your curry the best, Hiori!

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: カレーって、その家の味があるって言うし<CR>これが陽桜莉さんの味なんだよ
records.en_original: They say every family's curry tastes different. This curry is Hiori's flavor.
records.en: They say every family's curry tastes different. This curry is Hiori's flavor.

records.jp: 私の味……
records.en_original: My flavor...
records.en: My flavor...

records.jp: ……ううん、違うよ
records.en_original: No it's not.
records.en: No it's not.

records.jp: これは、私と愛央ちゃんの味！<CR>だって、ふたりで作ったんだもん
records.en_original: This is our flavor, Ao! We cooked it together, didn't we?
records.en: This is our flavor, Ao! We cooked it together, didn't we?

records.jp: あはは、たしかに！
records.en_original: Ahaha, that's true!
records.en: Ahaha, that's true!

records.jp: じゃあ、このカレーが食べたくなったら<CR>ふたりで一緒に作らないとだめだね
records.en_original: So next time I want curry, we'll have to make it together!
records.en: So next time I want curry, we'll have to make it together!

records.jp: うん！　また一緒に作ろ！
records.en_original: Yeah! We should definitely make it again sometime!
records.en: Yeah! We should definitely make it again sometime!

records.jp: さーてと、じゃあご飯を……あっ！
records.en_original: Okay, now let's get the rice, and... Aaah!
records.en: Okay, now let's get the rice, and... Aaah!

records.jp: ご飯、炊くの忘れてた！
records.en_original: We forgot to make rice!
records.en: We forgot to make rice!

records.jp: ああっ！？
records.en_original: Noooo!
records.en: Noooo!

records.jp: ど、どうしよう……<CR>カレーなのに
records.en_original: Wh-what should we do...? We can't eat curry by itself...
records.en: Wh-what should we do...? We can't eat curry by itself...

records.jp: ナンを作ろう！
records.en_original: Let's make naan!
records.en: Let's make naan!

records.jp: はっ、その手が！<CR>でも、どうやって作れば……？
records.en_original: Ah, yes! But, how do we make it...?
records.en: Ah, yes! But, how do we make it...?

records.jp: とりあえず、小麦粉をこねて焼いてみよう
records.en_original: Let's just try kneading some flour and cooking it!
records.en: Let's just try kneading some flour and cooking it!

records.jp: ……これ、ナンっていうか板？
records.en_original: Mmm... This is like trying to eat a plank of wood.
records.en: Mmm... This is like trying to eat a plank of wood.

records.jp: 料理って、こんなに固いものも作れるんだ。<CR>なんか、すごいねぇ
records.en_original: I didn't know it was possible to cook something this hard. I'm kind of amazed.
records.en: I didn't know it was possible to cook something this hard. I'm kind of amazed.

records.jp: うう、ごめん……折角、陽桜莉さんが<CR>カレー作ってくれたのに
records.en_original: Aww, I'm sorry... You worked so hard on the curry too...
records.en: Aww, I'm sorry... You worked so hard on the curry too...

records.jp: あはは、あやまらなくていいよ
records.en_original: Ahaha, you don't need to apologize.
records.en: Ahaha, you don't need to apologize.

records.jp: こうやって、愛央ちゃんと一緒に何かするの<CR>すっごく楽しいし！
records.en_original: I just like doing things with you, Ao!
records.en: I just like doing things with you, Ao!

records.jp: もういっかい、挑戦しよう。<CR>次は、きっとうまくいくから！
records.en_original: Let's give it one more try. I'm sure it'll turn out good this time!
records.en: Let's give it one more try. I'm sure it'll turn out good this time!

records.jp: よーし、やるぞー！
records.en_original: Okay, let's do it!
records.en: Okay, let's do it!

records.jp: 炊きあがるまで、待つしかないね
records.en_original: I guess we'll just have to wait for the rice to cook.
records.en: I guess we'll just have to wait for the rice to cook.

records.jp: どれぐらいかかるんだろ？
records.en_original: How long will it take?
records.en: How long will it take?

records.jp: えっと……５０分ぐらいかな？
records.en_original: Um... About 50 minutes?
records.en: Um... About 50 minutes?

records.jp: うわ、結構あるね。<CR>どうしよ、カレーだけで食べちゃう？
records.en_original: Wow, that's longer than I thought. What should we do? Just eat the curry like this?
records.en: Wow, that's longer than I thought. What should we do? Just eat the curry like this?

records.jp: 大丈夫。ふたりで、おしゃべりしてたら<CR>５０分なんてあっという間だよ
records.en_original: It's okay. We can just sit here and chat. The 50 minutes will go by before we know it.
records.en: It's okay. We can just sit here and chat. The 50 minutes will go by before we know it.

records.en_original: Uh...
records.en: Uh...

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんと、一緒にいるといつもそうなんだ。<CR>気が付くと一日が終わってる感じ
records.en_original: That's what always happens when I'm with you, Ao. I feel like the whole day just flies by.
records.en: That's what always happens when I'm with you, Ao. I feel like the whole day just flies by.

records.jp: あまりにも時間が早く過ぎるから、<CR>止まって～って、思っちゃう
records.en_original: Time goes so fast that I feel like yelling at it and telling it to stop.
records.en: Time goes so fast that I feel like yelling at it and telling it to stop.

records.jp: 私も！　同じ！<CR>もっと陽桜莉さんと、一緒にいたい！
records.en_original: Me too! I feel the same way! I just want to be with you, Hiori!
records.en: Me too! I feel the same way! I just want to be with you, Hiori!

records.jp: あ、今のはえっと……<CR>もっと色んなこと話したいなーって意味で……
records.en_original: Uh—I mean... I want to...spend more time talking with you...
records.en: Uh—I mean... I want to...spend more time talking with you...

records.jp: う、うん！　分かってる、分かってる！
records.en_original: Y-yeah! I know, I know!
records.en: Y-yeah! I know, I know!

records.jp: 今のは……<CR>そう言う意味じゃないよね……
records.en_original: I know you didn't mean it...THAT way...
records.en: I know you didn't mean it...THAT way...

records.jp: ん？　何？
records.en_original: Huh? What way?
records.en: Huh? What way?

records.jp: ううん！　なんでもなーい！
records.en_original: Nothing! Don't worry about it!
records.en: Nothing! Don't worry about it!
